species.name: Crappie
why: Water 61°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 10–14 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 70 ft, so fish stay above it.
